opponents.description: The opponents to collect as-collected data for. Names are seeded by gp-api from campaignStrategyOpponent; the URL hints are optional and used as a starting point when present.

full_name.description: The opponent's full name. Used both for source discovery via WebSearch and as the opponent_name on every emitted item.

ballotpedia_url.description: Optional hint: the opponent's Ballotpedia page if gp-api already knows it. When present, use it directly; when null/absent, discover it via WebSearch.

website_url.description: Optional hint: the opponent's campaign website if gp-api already knows it. When present, use it directly; when null/absent, discover it via WebSearch.

race_context.description: The race the opponents are running in, hydrated by gp-api before dispatch. Used only to disambiguate the right person/page during discovery (same office, jurisdiction, cycle). The agent does NOT reason over it beyond that.

election_date.description: The election date for this race, or null. Used to confirm the right cycle during discovery.

items.description: One entry per (opponent, source) actually found and fetched. A source that could not be found or fetched is omitted entirely (never invented). An opponent with neither source contributes zero entries; the array may be empty if no source was fetched for any opponent.

opponent_name.description: The opponent this collected content is about. Matches one of the input opponents' full_name.

source_type.description: Which of the two sources this content came from.

source_url.description: The page actually fetched (the broker's returned source_url after any redirect). Required — every item is grounded in a real fetched URL.

content.description: Unstructured extracted page text/sections, as collected. Deliberately not normalized into named fields — that is a later-phase decision. Capture the page text as-is.
